title: fix(spec, runtime): endpoint refusal, hint and describes no longer name 17.x as the running major
body:
Closes #24654

Clause-②: no

## What changed

Four customer-facing sentences said "in 17.x", but 18.x is the running major and the behaviour they describe has not changed. Each one now says what the runtime does without naming a version, so it cannot go stale again at 19.0. ⛔ No behaviour change, no new gate.

| where | reader | now reads |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint-publish-gate.ts` | the `os build` / `os validate` refusal for a `script` / `proxy` endpoint | "This runtime executes only 'object_operation' and 'flow' endpoints. `script` is refused because ..." |
| `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.ts` (`hint`) | the API caller, in the `unsupported` answer | "This runtime executes only 'object_operation' and 'flow' endpoints. 'script' and 'proxy' are rejected at publish ..." (word for word the same first sentence as the spec refusal) |
| `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint.zod.ts` `type` describe | readers of the published schema | "Implementation type — this runtime EXECUTES only 'object_operation' and 'flow'. ..." |
| `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint.zod.ts` `ApiMapping.transform` describe | the same | "Transformation function name — NOT EXECUTED by this runtime, and publish REJECTS the key ..." |

Same PR, maintainer-facing JSDoc: `packages/runtime/src/api-mapping.ts` (the mirrored `transform` describe row) and `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.ts` (the `params` "always `{}`" notes and the `planEndpointTarget` doc).

**Bounded in-place fix, named here:** `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint.zod.ts`, `ApiEndpoint.target` describe, said the Script Name / Proxy URL spellings "stay unreachable in 17.x". It is the same defect class, in the same file, on the same schema, and the same gate family covers it (`check:docs`). It now reads "stay unreachable on this runtime". Evidence: the regenerated `content/docs/references/api/endpoint.mdx` row for `target`.

Pins: no test asserted the old text (`git grep -nE "execute in 17|EXECUTED in 17|EXECUTE in 17"` over `*.test.ts` returns 0 hits). Two test TITLES in `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.test.ts` repeated "in 17.x". They were reworded and their assertions are unchanged.

Regenerated with repo tooling: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` found `check:docs` stale (1 of 14), regenerated `content/docs/references/api/endpoint.mdx` and re-checked it green. Changeset: `.changeset/24654-endpoint-text-version-free.md`, `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/runtime`.

## Verification (head `f8e3a95abf`, which includes a merge of `origin/main` `0431002104`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`, post-merge: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date", lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` at `f8e3a95abf`: 701 files passed, 1 skipped; 21347 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` at `018b472bd5` (the change itself, before the merge): 425 files passed; 6678 tests passed, 19 skipped; typecheck exit 0. The merge brought no change to the files this PR edits. The runtime suite was not re-run on the merge head; CI runs it there.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 110 commands at `f8e3a95abf`. All of them were run, and `--ran` reconciles: "110 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 109 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. Reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3). It needs a full workspace build, and this worktree only built the runtime dependency closure.
  - `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 1 because `@objectstack/spec` dist was missing: a spec rebuild was running at the same time. Re-run after the build finished: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

Other "in 17.x" sites outside this card's file surface. None of them was edited here:

- `packages/rest/src/openapi-endpoints.ts:218`: `unsupportedReason` says "which this runtime does not execute in 17.x". This is customer-facing OpenAPI output for the same endpoint family. It is reported to the seat as a finding.
- `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:163`: "`script` / `proxy` do not execute in 17.x". This is the published skill text, a Tier H surface. It is reported to the seat.
- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:845` (JSDoc), `packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts:210` (JSDoc, with the test title `metadata-service.test.ts:485`), `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-node-expression-paths.ts:126` (JSDoc), `packages/spec/liveness/api.json:15` (ledger note): maintainer-facing only.
